name: 100 validation and100 test seven-judge study
authorization: User explicitly requested100 validation cases; standardized to100 validation plus100 test per backbone/dataset,200 total,60000 prompts per judge
new_judgments: At most 300000, less already-committed selected Mistral judgments
data_policy: Frozen probes, scores, splits, thresholds, explanation text and source-group separation remain unchanged. Only judging sample is reduced. Revised nested selection weights replace parent weights in reduced analysis. No training/extraction.
hard_output: Exactly one digit 0 or 1, one-token allowed-label restriction. Preserve raw output and log probabilities.
probability_output: Exactly one integer 0 through 100 denoting positive-class probability, native structured choice decoding, max_tokens=8. No label or rationale. >=50 and validation-tuned decisions derived downstream.
sampling: Outcome-blind nested subsample of parent score-decile x gold-label strata. Fixed seed20261011, SHA256 of seed/budget110/backbone/dataset/stratum/immutable ID. Equal round-robin quotas with shortage redistribution; keep100 validation and100 test per pair. Inclusion probability is original inclusion probability times conditional selected/parent stratum count. Preserve parent order and prompt IDs. Original budget110 hash-domain separator is deliberately retained so quota100 is nested in quota110; no outcome-dependent selection.
thresholds: Use identical validation-derived probe threshold candidates. Maximize weighted validation F1; ties within1e-12 select highest probe threshold then highest judge cutoff. Judge cutoffs0..101. Apply frozen selections to weighted held-out test. Never pick test maxima as held-out winners.
runtime: Each additional model loaded once and run sequentially on GPU. Per-model known safe batch sizes Mistral16, OLMo8, GLM8, Qwen1224, Llama4. Determine max input length over all exact untruncated prompts per model. Eager, no prefix caching, per-model prior precision; explicit nonreasoning template. Report differences in inference configs; vLLM is not bitwise deterministic.
replay: Existing600000 verified outputs are referenced intact. No reuse of old other-model fixed-flag outputs because complete new inference configurations do not match. Each new batch writes an intent before generation, raw output before validation, and checksum-protected commit afterward. Ambiguous attempts halt without automatic regeneration. Committed outputs never silently regenerated.
recovery: Only safe non-destructive repairs. Preserve failed attempts, frozen data, model revisions, environments and keepalives. Halt below20GiB free on project or model-cache volume. Numerical replay agreement checks remain diagnostic only; not reintroduced.
evaluation: Exact probe-only metrics, weighted test pipeline estimates, precision/recall/F1, referral and input-token costs, per-dataset/backbone/judge results, paired comparisons and probability calibration with original scientific limits. All three explanation conditions equally tuned. Fixed50 ablation uses saved probabilities without additional calls.
external: CSV prompt_id plus exact separate system/user messages and output_type. Return minimal rows prompt_id,model,response,status,input_tokens,output_tokens,latency_ms; save exact provider/revision/settings separately in model manifest. Do not include gold target labels, retrievable splits, probabilities or weights in sent prompt messages. No external API calls are performed by this local task.
reuse: Reuse all retained Qwen/Gemma and Mistral outputs from both earlier study directories via flattened original batch/raw/config provenance. Never regenerate a previously committed selected answer.
limits: Smaller per-dataset validation/test samples increase tuning instability and uncertainty. Existing test inspection and prior full-sample results limit confirmatory claims. Main seven-judge comparison uses same reduced cases for every judge. Full Qwen/Gemma outputs retained separately.
runtime_cost_caveat: Retrospectively reused rows retain original full-batch measured times including unselected rows. Report these separately from new reduced-run timing; do not interpret retained batch sums as runtime for a freshly collected reduced sample.
